_meta.comment: Bundled SynthBench routing.json snapshot. Used when the live URL is unreachable and no user cache exists. Built by a local SynthBench run of the routing builder (routing contract v1) before routing.json was published at https://synthbench.org/data/routing.json. Replace with the published file on the next refresh.

topics.label: Politics and policy
topics.description: Elections, parties, government, political leaders, laws and public policy, immigration.

topics.label: Economy and work
topics.description: The economy, jobs and careers, income and inequality, personal finances, social class.

topics.label: Technology and media
topics.description: Technology and automation, the internet and social media, news media, data and privacy, large companies and banks.

topics.label: Science and health
topics.description: Science and scientists, the environment and climate, medicine, the health care system, personal health, and the condition of local communities (local problems, neighbors, urban and rural life).

topics.label: Identity and values
topics.description: Race and ethnicity, gender and sexuality, discrimination, religion, personal values and morality.

topics.label: Family, community and safety
topics.description: Family and relationships, crime and safety, education, and how people see the future.

topics.label: Global affairs
topics.description: Foreign policy, other countries and international relations, war and security, global institutions.
